entries.appliesTo: Maryland's Future Board (Department of Commerce), the State Treasurer/Comptroller (Fund), and the Comptroller (study) — state government only

params.program: Maryland's Future Board — visionary plan covering AI/robotics/automation trends

sources.program: § 2.5–302(A) & § 2.5–301(E)(4) — 'THERE IS A MARYLAND'S FUTURE BOARD IN THE DEPARTMENT' … 'STRATEGIES THAT IMAGINE FUTURE TRENDS IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: (I) ROBOTICS AND AUTOMATION; (II) ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'

flags: AI is incidental: this is an economic-development board bill; artificial intelligence appears only as one of the future-trend areas the visionary plan must imagine (§ 2.5–301(E)(4)(II)) and as an optional Comptroller study topic (Section 2(a)(3)(ii) — 'job replacement due to the rise in artificial intelligence')

Board must develop a visionary plan on or before January 1, 2027 (§ 2.5–303(A)), evaluate/revise it at least annually (§ 2.5–303(B)), and submit annual project recommendations each August 1 beginning 2027 (§ 2.5–303(D)) — internal-government planning/reporting duties with no matching duty key
Comptroller must report study results to the General Assembly on or before December 1, 2026 (Section 2(b))
Sunset: Act abrogated at the end of June 30, 2031 (Section 3 — 'shall remain effective for a period of 5 years')
No penalty or enforcement provision anywhere in the Act — exposure omitted
Crossfiled with MD SB 770 per legiscan relations; no replaced-by relation, HB 1473 is the enacted chapter (Ch. 378)
